usedFor: Worksection tracks projects, and Google Docs logs work when “Task Completed in Project” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Completed in Project” in Worksection, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Finished tasks are written into a doc tab, giving you a running record to share.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so set it to add, not replace.
